reviewFinding: The existing proxy is a host-side Unix-domain HTTP proxy with fixed POST /v1/responses, bounded request/response bytes, quotas, deadlines, closed policy, sanitized errors/logs, and cleanup proofs. The OCI facade and relay also reject missing Docker/cgroup/base provenance and prove stopped/cgroup cleanup in their existing tests.
qualificationBoundary: These tests validate the existing experimental interface and static/offline safety contracts; they do not qualify a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner and do not authorize provider credential use.
